still._prompt_note: Dani's shading tags and negative as the base (docs/art/pipeline.md). The warm-light negatives (orange, yellow trim) are dropped because the Scav is rust and amber; the hood, the olive and the dirt are weighted like Dani's accents; 'holding, weapon' are negative because the pipe is a prop still.
still._chosen_note: shaded seed 8: the one profile T-pose of ten, already facing right. Hood up, one glowing eye, olive coat over a rust shirt, taped boots; both hands drawn on the extended arm, the lower one is cut into a discard part.

target._settings_note: Dani's target block (the template), sizes from the cast.md table: 50 art px tall in a 60x56 frame (120x112 screen; 52 clipped the pipe in the windup and the lunge), collider 44x80 unchanged, feet on its bottom edge. The palette is the Scav's own: olive and rust ramps, amber for the eye, grey for the pipe.

rig._comment: Joints in still pixels (832x1216, facing right, profile). The near arm is the extended one (rest 90, poses assume it hangs) and is cut in three: upper, forearm, hand; the pipe (props.pipe) hangs from the palm joint hand_near, parented to the hand. The coat is long: its back tail is a torso part (coat_back, drawn first) so the thighs carry only the front flaps and the legs can swing; the still's far shin and far hand are discards; far limbs are darkened copies set a little behind.

cast.md: the face is lost in the hood. The pale skin (which baked to white) and the orange fringe go into shadow; the iris is at hue 42 by now and is left alone

parts.name: pipe

parts._rest_why: the prop still draws the pipe upright; rest 90 on top of the hanging arm makes angle 0 continue the forearm, business end outward
parts._scale_why: the straight run is 886 px in the prop still; 0.55 makes it 21 art px, thigh to shin when it hangs, 2-3 art px thick
